result.rationale: Infusion Health KVH General Partnership is the legal ProjectCo. BBGI acquired 50% in 2013, acquired the remaining 50% on August 19, 2020 and still described the ProjectCo as wholly owned in April 2026. Equitix and Dalmore must be retained as former indirect Jura/JLIF owners ending August 19, 2020; BCI is an upstream BBGI owner, not a separate ProjectCo owner.

evidence.purpose: Confirms the legal ProjectCo and original ownership chains.
Confirms BBGI completed its initial 50% acquisition in November 2013.
Confirms BBGI acquired the remaining 50% and reached 100% ownership on August 19, 2020.
Current BBGI evidence describing Infusion Health as wholly owned in 2026.
